body:
Road conditions

  • (888)401-4511-Road conditions/ construction
  • http://www.dot.state.ri.us/traffic/index.html (Road construction/ restrictions chart)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide
  • Over 13'6" high
  • Trailer over 48'6" long

Special Information Needed

  • Registered weight; trailer license plate

Times Of Movement

  • 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset; no weekend travel allowed
  • Travel prohibited on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Victory Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veteran’s Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas. If a holiday falls on Sunday, the following Monday is also restricted. If the holiday falls on Saturday, the previous Friday is restricted after noon. If a holiday falls during the week, travelis allowed up to noon on the day vefore the holiday. The permit office will be close on these holidays plus Martin Luther King Day & Election Day.

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • Width over 12' up to 14'6"-1
  • Width over 14'6"-2
  • Length over 80' up to 90'-1
  • Length over 90'-2
  • Height over 14'-1
  • Overhang of 15' or more-1
  • Infrequent-overhang of 15' or more (example: 2-lane hwy w/ width 12' or more)-2
  • Building-with police escort-2
  • Cranes-interstate moves of 12' or over-2

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: At least as large as a compact car
  • Signs: Oversize load sign on front and/or rear depending on vehicle & load
  • Lights: Yellow lights (visible from front & rear) in operation above the highest point of the vehicle
  • Flags:
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • No Stipulations
  • Dept. of Transportation Permits Office-Hours: 8:30a.m.-3:30p.m. Mon.-Fri.
  • Division of Motor Vehicles
  • OS/OW Permits
  • 286 Main St., Rm. 103
  • Pawtucket, RI 02860
  • 401-588-3020 x 2031 (permit office); x2032 (oversize); x2029 (overweight); x2036 (motor vehicle)
  • All permits are issued by commercial permit services
